_comment: Which processes are using the network. Linux uses per-socket TCP counters from `ss` plus `/proc`; macOS uses all-protocol per-process counters from `nettop`. The pane names the active measurement. Totals start at zero each launch.
_interval_comment: Seconds between applied source samples. macOS nettop has a one-second minimum; redraw and selection remain independent.
_limit_comment: Maximum process rows; 0 means no configured limit.
_sort_comment: Initial ordering: total bytes or live rate.
_external_comment: Linux only: narrow socket rows to internet peers. macOS process totals have no peer field.
_mine_comment: Linux only: hide unattributed sockets initially. macOS nettop rows are already process-labelled.
